title: The Widest Fenced Yard
statement:
`n` posts stand in a straight line, one unit apart, with heights `h_1, ..., h_n`. A rope is stretched between two different posts `i < j` and a tarp is hung on it; the tarp can only be as tall as the shorter of the two posts, and it spans the distance `j - i`. The area covered is `min(h_i, h_j) * (j - i)`. Find the largest area that any pair of posts can cover.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `n` integers, the heights of the posts in order.

## Output
Print the largest possible area.

## Constraints
- `2 <= n <= 100000`
- `0 <= h_i <= 10^9`
